title: Size of the Returned Payment against Its Fee: Crestline Credit Card Courtesy Addition
content:
Northgate's returned-fee courtesy credit on the Crestline Credit Card eases a returned payment fee that is heavy against the payment that came back: when the returned payment was less than 3 times the fee, 0.15 is added to the share of the returned payment fee that the courtesy credit returns; when it was at least 3 times but less than 10 times the fee, 0.05 is added; otherwise nothing is added. The share, with every addition made to it, never exceeds 1.0 — the whole fee.

**Figures compared:** the most recent returned payment fee entry, and the amount of the returned payment it was charged for (the returned payment entry carrying the same payment confirmation number).

| Returned payment compared with its fee | Added to the share |
|---|---|
| less than 3 times the fee | 0.15 |
| 3 times or more, less than 10 times | 0.05 |
| 10 times or more | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical fee of 25.00 USD)

| Returned payment | Added |
|---|---|
| 74.99 USD | 0.15 |
| 75.00 USD (exactly 3 times) | 0.05 |
| 249.99 USD | 0.05 |
| 250.00 USD (exactly 10 times) | nothing |
